question: Students A, B, C, D and E will be reading the NEWS headlines in their school assembly on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Friday of the same week. Student C will be reading the NEWS on the starting day. Student E will be reading the NEWS just before student B and just after student A. Three students will be reading NEWS between C and D. Find the order in which the students will be reading the NEWS from Monday to Friday from the given four options.
